nodes.summary: The hypothesis CR₃^Sel is the following assertion. Let $d$ be a squarefree positive integer with $d\equiv5\pmod8$. Suppose that the 2-Selmer group $\mathrm{Sel}_2(C_d)$ has exactly $8$ elements and contains a pair $(a,b)$ with $|a|\equiv7\pmod8$. Then for every $(a',b')\in\mathrm{Sel}_2(C_d)$ the 2-covering $D_{a',b'}$ is soluble over $\mathbb Q$ (in its x-form).
